The biggest risk in this occupation is not AI but model misspecification plus regulatory change. One pricing error can create a long-term liability, and a rule change can force a full recalculation. Human judgment and final compliance review remain essential.

No matter how capable the system becomes, actuaries still decide which assumptions to use, how much reserve to hold, and how to explain the result to regulators. A person must think it through, sign it, and take responsibility. The human role in actuarial work cannot be removed entirely.
